$comment: Manual network edits for pipeline:rivers in reference mode (R3.2). Rule: every entry needs an APRHI line as evidence (precedence APRHI > IGN > HydroRIVERS); systems without that evidence stay endorheic in their APRHI root. 'rootOverrides' reassign a reach to another root BEFORE the cross-root cut, so the HydroRIVERS edges between it and that root are kept (used where the HydroRIVERS path of an APRHI river crosses level-12 polygons assigned to another root). Each needs reach, root, reason, evidence; the reach must be selected and the root must exist. 'overrides' set NEXT_DOWN of a terminal reach (after the cuts) to another reach of the same root (from, to, reason, evidence); pipeline:rivers fails if one is invalid: both reaches selected, same root, `from` a terminal after the cuts, no cycle. 'reason' says why; 'evidence' cites the APRHI line name and distances.

rootOverrides.reason: Río Quinto main stem: HydroRIVERS path 61506035 → 61506350 → 61506654 → 61507255 crosses two level-12 polygons assigned to 03.
rootOverrides.evidence: APRHI CursosDeAgua 'R. Quinto (Popopis)' within 0 m of 61506035 and 61507255; both reaches are on that path (HR_NEXT_DOWN), 17.2 km.
